notes: «سأل محمد بن مسلم أحدهما»: the asker is not a link when the report is the Imam's answer (rule 5); the Imam is named only inside the words as «أحدهما», so he is the single link (rule 10, ruling 2).
«سأل محمد بن مسلم أحدهما»: the asker is not a link when the report is the Imam's answer (rule 5); the Imam is named only inside the words as «أحدهما», so he is the single link (rule 10, ruling 2).
«وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ أَحَدَهُمَا» is rule 5: the asker is not a link when the report is the Imam's; the Imam is the last link, written as the report names him («أحدهما»)
